description: §4.12.2 / §43.4 (S445 item 5) control — the §43.4 supervision attributes (`restart=`, `max-restarts=`, `within=`) are nested-valid (§4.12.2 table), so a nested worker carrying them raises no E-PROGRAM-NESTED-ATTR.
rationale: §43.4: 'Supervision policy (`restart=`, `max-restarts=`, `within=`) SHALL be declared as attributes on the `<program>` element'; §4.12.2 lists them as valid in nested position.
